# CHAESSI PRESET v3.8.5 · Image sizes and Reader prompt transfer

## Wide and tall image sizes

Choose **Image size** at the bottom of the workbench, then **Normal** or **Large**. Check the width × height on the button and choose **Apply size**. The new Wide landscape and Tall portrait buttons are workbench shortcuts for V5 custom dimensions.

| Size | Standard landscape | Wide landscape | Standard portrait | Tall portrait | Square |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Normal | 1216 × 832 | 1344 × 768 | 832 × 1216 | 768 × 1344 | 1024 × 1024 |
| Large | 1536 × 1024 | 1664 × 960 | 1024 × 1536 | 960 × 1664 | 1472 × 1472 |

Try Wide landscape for a group or a broad background. Tall portrait gives you more vertical space for a full-length figure. Framing depends on the prompt and the generated result. The starting size is 832 × 1216. Small, Wallpaper, Custom and width/height swap are still available. Your saved sizes, prompts and camera settings stay as you set them. Large uses more pixels and can change the cost. Check the estimate before generating.

[Image size guide](https://doomokddonggae.github.io/Chaessi-Preset/v3.8.5/?lang=en&chapter=settings)

## Send selected text to a running v3.8.5 draft

Edit the text in the separately installed Chaessi Metadata Reader. Add a selection or an entire field, then choose **Send to Preset → Connect to Preset**. Start the single-file Portable first. Check the version, executable path and PID of the window that should receive your text.

Assign a Base or Character field, Positive or Undesired, and **Append** or **Replace** to each item. Medium offers Positive fields only. Multiple items appear in your chosen order. Choose **Review changes in Preset**, compare the current and final text, then choose **Apply to draft** or **Cancel**. Use **Undo Reader transfer** to reverse the last applied transfer.

Transfer needs no NovelAI token or paid generation. Applying text does not save presets, write History, generate images, call NovelAI or change the model or effort. Save the draft in Preset yourself if you want to keep it.

[Reader installation, first-time setup and compatible version](../../README.en.md#reader-setup) · [Illustrated Reader guide](https://doomokddonggae.github.io/Chaessi-Preset/v3.8.5/?lang=en&chapter=reader-transfer)
